items.text: Apples now have only a 10% chance to survive if the tree is harvested before picking; fruit no longer falls when hitting a tree, and natural beehives still drop honeycomb and a swarm on full harvest.
Beef spoilage now correctly assigns the spoil item, preventing loss of food value.
Apartment complexes are marked as safe zones, restoring the hostile‑nearby warning, and the building‑proximity check was fixed, eliminating construction errors near apartments.
Fence placement refined: fences no longer sink into terrain, can be placed on slopes up to 20°, and socket rotation bugs were removed.
Explosive weapons now include prefab setups and crater definitions that respect 3D shapes and blocking objects, improving blast effects and terrain deformation realism.
New high‑tier loot rooms added: Junkyard, NMS launch site, Water Treatment Plant, and Sewer branch, increasing valuable loot spawns.

Frontier and pilot hazmat suits regained missing BC components, restoring protection after rerigging; hunting trophies now include cow, bull, and sheep variants with reduced prefab size for better performance.
Overall critter population balanced and turtle spawning frequency fixed.
Sheep become hostile toward attackers after being marked, and their model/AI was corrected so they walk, attack, and die properly.
Player bot reporting fixed; server browser filters now work as expected; player count display remains stable when switching game mode tabs.
New bind command added for gamepad defaults, fixing reset issues when no mouse/keyboard is bound.

2026-09-15.summary:
### Resources & Harvesting
- Apples now have only a 10% chance to survive if the tree is harvested before picking; fruit no longer falls when hitting a tree, and natural beehives still drop honeycomb and a swarm on full harvest.
- Beef spoilage now correctly assigns the spoil item, preventing loss of food value.

### Safe Zones & Hostile Alerts
- Apartment complexes are marked as safe zones, restoring the hostile‑nearby warning, and the building‑proximity check was fixed, eliminating construction errors near apartments.

### Base Building & Explosives
- Fence placement refined: fences no longer sink into terrain, can be placed on slopes up to 20°, and socket rotation bugs were removed.
- Explosive weapons now include prefab setups and crater definitions that respect 3D shapes and blocking objects, improving blast effects and terrain deformation realism.

### Loot & Equipment
- New high‑tier loot rooms added: Junkyard, NMS launch site, Water Treatment Plant, and Sewer branch, increasing valuable loot spawns.
- Frontier and pilot hazmat suits regained missing BC components, restoring protection after rerigging; hunting trophies now include cow, bull, and sheep variants with reduced prefab size for better performance.

### Animals & AI
- Overall critter population balanced and turtle spawning frequency fixed.
- Sheep become hostile toward attackers after being marked, and their model/AI was corrected so they walk, attack, and die properly.

### Gameplay & Controls
- Player bot reporting fixed; server browser filters now work as expected; player count display remains stable when switching game mode tabs.
- New bind command added for gamepad defaults, fixing reset issues when no mouse/keyboard is bound.

items.text: Fixed inaccurate server browser gamemode filter counts and prevented mixing of unrelated gamemodes.
Fixed various input binding issues, including gamepad key‑assign closure, key latching after input clear, and missing map close binding.
Restored missing beef resource links for livestock.
Lamb and calf corpses no longer yield any resources when killed.
Attacking farm animals now marks you as hostile to safezones.
Adjusted critter population settings.
Fixed issues with multiple animals near vehicles and added support for mounting Gen2 AI via a new NPCMountable component.
Halved fence gate opening/closing speed for smoother operation.
Fixed fence collider issues, enabled fence demolition, and added blue highlight to demolishable fences.
Fixed hitbox collision detection errors.
Adjusted salvaged cleaver distance to correct melee reach.
Fixed raw beef missing its cooking reference and added new meat types to all oven prefabs.
Store images now correctly generate and display blurhash placeholders, preventing missing or broken backgrounds in the store UI.
Editor now reads textures as sRGB when possible, improving color accuracy of generated blurhash previews.

2026-09-14.summary:
### Server & UI
- Fixed inaccurate server browser gamemode filter counts and prevented mixing of unrelated gamemodes.
- Fixed various input binding issues, including gamepad key‑assign closure, key latching after input clear, and missing map close binding.

### Animals, Resources & Mounting
- Restored missing beef resource links for livestock.
- Lamb and calf corpses no longer yield any resources when killed.
- Attacking farm animals now marks you as hostile to safezones.
- Adjusted critter population settings.
- Fixed issues with multiple animals near vehicles and added support for mounting Gen2 AI via a new NPCMountable component.

### Structures & Collision
- Halved fence gate opening/closing speed for smoother operation.
- Fixed fence collider issues, enabled fence demolition, and added blue highlight to demolishable fences.
- Fixed hitbox collision detection errors.

### Combat, Weapons & Cooking
- Adjusted salvaged cleaver distance to correct melee reach.
- Fixed raw beef missing its cooking reference and added new meat types to all oven prefabs.

### UI & Visuals
- Store images now correctly generate and display blurhash placeholders, preventing missing or broken backgrounds in the store UI.
- Editor now reads textures as sRGB when possible, improving color accuracy of generated blurhash previews.
